style: Avant-garde post-punk cabaret, microtonal undercurrents, subharmonic overtone fields. [HARMONY] Parallel triads moving as a single block, modal drones with shifting scale degrees, non-diatonic clusters interrupting diatonic sweetness. [MELODIC] Angular phrasing, rapid micro-intervals, yodel register flips, abrupt leaps, ornamental folk turns. [RHYTHM] Asymmetric polymeter 5 against 4, polyrhythmic 3 against 4, motorik pulse with periodic missing beats, stop-start silence. [TIMBRE] Talking drum, santoor, ney, clavioline, stylophone, subtractive synthesis, daxophone, gamelan metallophones. [PERFORMANCE] Theatrical exaggeration, camp overcommitment, urgent sensory overload, deadpan precision. [ANCHOR] Recurring contact-pulse rhythm acting as invariant foundation. [TRANSFORMS] Compress rhythmic density while stretching microtonal intervals; make acoustic resonance behave like electronic filter cutoffs; preserve tactile pulse while destabilizing metric stability.
lyrics:
[SECTION 1 - OPENING: THE WAKE]
[Contact pulse: hand strikes wood with heavy rhythmic resonance]
[Simultaneous translation choir: three languages overlapping in dissonant waves]

[Igbo phonological transfer]
Wake. The compression hits. The heavy stuff falls downward with sudden force.
Dense matter seals the skull. I am packed inside the meat like an unwanted cargo.
Every morning is a slamming back into the red wall of physical existence.
[Ney breathy hollow tone drifting over the frequencies]
[Talking drum pitch bend mimicking vocal inflection]

I hate the weight of skin. I want it off of me, torn and discarded.
The meat is loud. The meat is wet with perpetual useless fluids.
The meat is grease and bone and iron debt that can never be paid.
[Clavioline reedy early-electronic lead piercing the atmospheric hum]
[One new fact per section: meat has volume and occupies cursed space]

[SECTION 2 - SENSORY OVERLOAD / CAMP SPECTACLE]
[Santoor hammered-zither cascade ringing through the upper registers]
[Subtractive synth filter cutoff sweeps up to reveal the harsh reality]

Oh, look at the pancreas! Look at the liver! So dramatic and pathetic!
A five-star tragedy performed in warm red lard and agonizing nerve endings!
[Stylophone buzzy electronic chirp mocking the organic machinery]
[Daxophone speech-like wooden groan scraping against the melody]

[Choir translation offset by three beats of absolute silence]
I did not ask for the radius of this femur or its hollow core.
I did not vote for the cartilage hinge that creaks with every motion.
Get the matter off my eyes! Clear the vision from the fog!
Peel the stuffing from my ribs until nothing remains but hollow space!
[Exertion decay: breathing grows ragged, tempo drags slightly into exhaustion]

[SECTION 3 - THE SUBHARMONIC DESCENT]
[Gamelan metallophone interlocking bronze keys echoing in an empty hall]
[Underdrone field drops below audible frequency, vibrating the floorboards]

[Every event gets explained later: the slam is caused by gravity and structural collapse]
We remember the unformed state before the gravity took hold.
Before the marrow locked its doors against the infinite void.
Before the calcium set its trap and turned fluid into stone.
[Past voice interrupts present: unedited recording from yesterday playback]
'Is the enclosure sealed against the leaks?'
'Yes, the meat is airtight and completely submerged.'

[SECTION 4 - THE TONE SHIFT & RENDER FAILURE]
[Percussionist alters tempo drastically, ignoring vocals and cue markers]
[Checkpoint restart triggered: scar remains on vowel pronunciation permanently]

Meat. Meat. Meat. Meat. Meat.
A magnificent garment of absolute terror and endless suffering.
Wear it with a smile. Wear it with grease paint over the weeping eyes.
[Daxophone squeal cutting through the mix like a rusty saw blade]
[Ney air across reed edge breaks into white noise and distortion]

[SECTION 5 - RECURSIVE RECALL]
[Rare word licenses depleted: vocabulary restricted to basic physical nouns only]

Bone. Blood. Skin. Stuff. Matter. Weight. Pressure. Time.
Cannot go back. Cannot peel it off without fatal consequence.
The room is red. The walls are closing in.
The day is heavy with unnecessary atmospheric drag.
The meat is me, and I am the meat, trapped forever.
[Simultaneous translation choir fades into a single collective breath]
[Final contact pulse stops abruptly mid-measure with no decay]
[Additional operational diagnostics: system running at maximum capacity without pause]
[Sub-routine checking structural integrity of vocal tracts and living membranes]
[All systems verified stable despite overwhelming existential load and catastrophic dread]
[End of transmission string loop parameters locked permanently in place without option for reset]
caption: An avant-garde cabaret post-punk collision governed by sensory overload and camp theatricality. A diverse palette of talking drums, santoors, neys, and analog synths performs within a subharmonic undertone field and conflicting polyrhythms. The lyrics chronicle the visceral horror of waking up trapped in physical matter, rendered through simultaneous translation choirs, L1 Igbo phonological transfer, and rigorous compositional constraints.
